scope: Staging, admission, and output bounds for specialized IMAGEDEF and IMAGEDEF_REACTOR DXF output.

behavior: IMAGEDEF plans refuse selected-reactor, common-reactor, or preserved-reactor collections above dwgSafety::MaxReactorCount (1,000,000).
writeObjects validates caller-owned IMAGEDEF collections before opening its OBJECTS output transaction.

The regenerated IMAGEDEF reactor list uses DRW::reserve, enforces the aggregate emitted-reference limit, and uses a second exception-catching reservation for duplicate detection while retaining source order for output.
The selected source-reactor lookup catches allocation exceptions and fails through the existing output rollback path.
writeImageRecord refuses another generated IMAGEDEF_REACTOR once the preserved-reactor bound is reached.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary IMAGEDEF records with 1,000,001 common reactor references refuse without publishing output.

The broader selector fails in the mode-1 AC1015-to-AC1015 ASCII projection during TABLES emission, before IMAGEDEF/IMAGEDEF_REACTOR output. Its adjacent FIELDLIST warning is not established as causal: the failing imported source had zero typed/raw FIELDLIST records and no NOD ACAD_FIELDLIST entry. The exact TABLES callback remains unidentified.

limitations: The 1,000,000 limit is the existing internal reactor resource ceiling, not an Autodesk format maximum or support claim.
Allocation-failure injection, unrelated OBJECTS assembly collections, and other copy/work bounds remain open.
The rooted IMAGEDEF closure selector now passes; this local result does not establish native CAD semantics or promote support claims.
next: Continue the bounded safety audit on remaining output staging paths and allocation-failure behavior; do not reopen the resolved TABLES proof issue without a new failure.

followUp.finding: The original rooted IMAGEDEF closure failure was caused by standard DWG TABLES proof rejecting a valid LAYER_CONTROL handle with no extension dictionary when EED table-name checks were active. The FIELDLIST warning was unrelated.
followUp.fix: The proof now validates the control/dictionary pair only when an extension dictionary is present. A present dictionary still requires a complete, unambiguous pair.
followUp.regressionControl: Generated AC1032 mode-1 setup asserts a captured control handle and absent extension dictionary; the rooted IMAGEDEF closure matrix now passes.
